messages.ui.rules.body:
Goal: explore each layer together, defeat its exit BOSS and finish all layers. The expedition fails when the entire team is down or dead.

WASD moves, LMB attacks, Space dodges. Skills: Q/E/R/F in keyboard mode, Q/W/E/R in mouse mode. Consumables: 1–4. Change bindings in Settings.

F2 switches mouse movement: hold RMB to move toward the pointer; click to pathfind. Tab changes camera. Click the minimap or press M for the inspection map.

Walk to entrances. Free passages cross directly. Press G at a personal entrance and confirm; each entrant pays. Ordinary battles lock doors during combat; join before combat or between waves.

Shared entrances and layer exits use physical voting devices. Reach an entrance, press G and stay nearby. Interact again or leave to withdraw. Once opened, entry is optional except for mandatory gatherings such as BOSS rooms.

With no shared AP, personal exploration and rescue remain available; advancement requires the enhanced BOSS. Spending the last shared AP on a normal BOSS keeps it normal. The enhanced curse reduces both initial AP values by 1 until cleansed and does not stack.

Zero health causes knockdown. Teammates can raise you after clearing the room. Each normal penalty linearly removes 25% maximum health and final damage. The fourth knockdown is fatal. Resurrection starts at count 1; the third subsequent knockdown is fatal.

The bag has 27 slots; 9 equipment slots are separate. Open the bag at bottom-right, select an item and equip/unequip it. Equipment can change in combat. Move near drops to collect them and near shop devices to buy or sell.

Click a teammate to trade. Distance, room and combat do not restrict it. Both players must confirm the same offer; currency cannot be traded directly. Equipment or offer changes require confirmation again.

Hover icons for summaries, hold Shift for calculations. Hover follows the pointer and cannot be dragged. Ordinary windows can coexist, move and close; wheel scrolls. Windows never pause gameplay.

Victory stores owned items and awards meta points. Learn upgrades in your hall. Warehouse gear cannot return to the main expedition. Special-mode and gameplay-mod progress cannot flow back to normal progress. Development content and balance remain provisional.
